name: MonarchAiComputerView
title: AiComputerView
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column composing MonarchCalloutBanner, MonarchButton, androidx.compose.foundation.Image with an androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas marker overlay, and MonarchLightbox to zoom the screenshot
summary: A live view of an AI agent operating a browser or a computer: the status, who is in control, pause, take over, hand back and stop, the latest screenshot with the agent's pointer and last action marked, and a log of every action.
whenToUse: While an agent acts in a browser or on a computer for the person, so they can watch, pause, take over for a step it must not do (signing in, paying) and stop it.
whenNotToUse: For a record of what agents did across the product, use MonarchAiActionLog. For an agent's plan before it acts, use MonarchAiPlan. For a remote-control screen, the app builds its own input surface.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiComputerView(status: MonarchAiComputerViewStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, frame: MonarchAiComputerFrame? = null, actions: List<MonarchAiComputerAction> = emptyList(), currentUrl: String? = null, windowTitle: String? = null, pointer: MonarchAiComputerPoint? = null, surface: MonarchAiComputerViewSurface = MonarchAiComputerViewSurface.Browser, waitingReason: String? = null, selectedActionId: String? = null, onSelectAction: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onPauseChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onTakeOver: (() -> Unit)? = null, onHandBack: (() -> Unit)? = null, onStop: (() -> Unit)? = null, showTypedText: Boolean = false, compact: Boolean = false, logExpanded: Boolean? = null, onLogExpandedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, announceIntervalMillis: Long = 4000L, visibleActions: Int = 200, locale: Locale? = null, timeZone: String? = null, live: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, liveSensitive: Boolean = false, labels: MonarchAiComputerViewLabels = MonarchAiComputerViewLabels())
class MonarchAiComputerFrame(image: Painter?, width: Int, height: Int, capturedAt: Long, alt: String? = null, sensitive: Boolean = false)

data class MonarchAiComputerAction(val id: String, val kind: MonarchAiComputerActionKind, val label: String, val at: Long, val point: MonarchAiComputerPoint? = null, val detail: String? = null, val sensitive: Boolean = false)
data class MonarchAiComputerPoint(val x: Int, val y: Int)
enum class MonarchAiComputerViewStatus { Starting, Working, Paused, WaitingForYou, TakenOver, Done, Failed, Stopped }
enum class MonarchAiComputerActionKind { Click, Type, Scroll, Navigate, Key, Wait, Read, Other }

class MonarchAiComputerViewLabels(label: ((MonarchAiComputerViewSurface) -> String)? = null, status: ((MonarchAiComputerViewStatus) -> String)? = null, agentInControl: ((MonarchAiComputerViewSurface) -> String)? = null, youInControl: ((MonarchAiComputerViewSurface) -> String)? = null, waitingTitle: String? = null, waitingFallback: String? = null, pause: String? = null, resume: String? = null, takeOver: String? = null, handBack: String? = null, stop: String? = null, stopQuestion: String? = null, stopConfirm: String? = null, stopCancel: String? = null, log: String? = null, logToggle: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, empty: String? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiComputerActionKind) -> String)? = null, hidden: String? = null, sensitiveLabel: String? = null, noFrame: String? = null, frameUnavailable: String? = null, frameHidden: String? = null, frameAlt: ((MonarchAiComputerViewSurface) -> String)? = null, liveAlt: ((MonarchAiComputerViewSurface) -> String)? = null, capturedAt: ((time: String) -> String)? = null, live: String? = null, address: String? = null, viewLarger: String? = null, frameDescription: ((alt: String, latest: String) -> String)? = null, expanded: String? = null, collapsed: String? = null, showEarlier: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, announceStatus: ((status: String) -> String)? = null, announceActions: ((count: Int, latest: String) -> String)? = null, announceTakenOver: ((MonarchAiComputerViewSurface) -> String)? = null, announceReleased: ((MonarchAiComputerViewSurface) -> String)? = null)

options.name: status
options.description: Where the session is. Each change is announced once.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the view.

options.name: frame
options.description: The latest screenshot: the Painter the app loaded, its pixel size, when it was taken, its text alternative and whether it may show private information.

options.name: actions
options.description: What the agent did, oldest first. Actions present at first are history; later ones are announced.

options.name: currentUrl
options.description: The page address, shown as text, left to right, with any user:password@ part removed.

options.name: windowTitle
options.description: The title of the window or page.

options.name: pointer
options.description: Where the agent's pointer is, in screenshot pixels.

options.name: surface
options.description: What the agent operates; only the wording changes.

options.name: waitingReason
options.description: Why the agent waits for the person, shown in the waiting notice.

options.name: selectedActionId
options.description: The action marked on the screenshot and highlighted in the log.

options.name: onSelectAction
options.description: Makes each logged action selectable; called with its id.

options.name: onPauseChange
options.description: Shows Pause while starting or working and Resume while paused.

options.name: onTakeOver
options.description: Shows Take over while the agent holds control; primary while it waits for the person.

options.name: onHandBack
options.description: Shows Hand back while the person has taken over.

options.name: onStop
options.description: Shows Stop until the session finishes; called after the inline confirmation.

options.name: showTypedText
options.description: Shows the detail of typing actions. Private actions stay hidden.

options.name: compact
options.description: Hides the log behind an "Actions (n)" button.

options.name: logExpanded
options.description: Whether the compact log shows; null lets the view keep it, starting hidden.

options.name: onLogExpandedChange
options.description: Called when the person shows or hides the compact log.

options.name: announceIntervalMillis
options.description: The shortest time between two action announcements; actions in between are announced together.

options.name: visibleActions
options.description: How many of the newest actions the log shows before "Show earlier".

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of the times.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone of the times. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: live
options.description: A live picture of the screen from the app, such as its video renderer; it replaces the screenshot and gets the same privacy rules.

options.name: liveSensitive
options.description: The live picture may show private information: it is never shown.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string; the ones that name the surface take it.

states.name: starting, working
states.description: The status, an info banner "The assistant is controlling this browser", Take over, Pause and Stop.

states.name: paused
states.description: Resume replaces Pause; no control banner.

states.name: waiting for you
states.description: A warning banner with "The assistant needs you to continue" and the reason; Take over is the primary button.

states.name: taken over
states.description: A neutral banner "You are controlling this browser" and Hand back.

states.name: done, failed, stopped
states.description: The status in the success, danger or default text role, no control buttons.

states.name: stop confirmation
states.description: Stop is replaced by the question, a danger Stop now and Keep going.

states.name: screenshot
states.description: The picture at its aspect ratio with the last action's point as an AI ring, the selected action's point as an accent ring with a dot, and the pointer as a dot; the capture time under it. A tap opens it in MonarchLightbox.

states.name: no screenshot or hidden
states.description: A muted box with "No screenshot yet", "Screenshot unavailable" or "Screenshot hidden: it may show private information".

states.name: log
states.description: Each action with its kind and time, its label, and its detail or "Hidden"; the selected one has the accent fill and a bar at its start.

appearance: The status uses the strong body style, coloured by the success, danger or warning strong role where it has one and always written out. The banners are MonarchCalloutBanner in the info, neutral and warning tones; the controls are small MonarchButtons (Take over or Hand back primary when they are the expected step, Stop danger). The screen box has the muted fill and default border; markers use the AI solid and accent solid roles and the pointer the default text role outlined with the surface role. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from the theme roles.
platformNotes: The web shows the screen beside the log on wide screens; on a phone the controls come first so they stay in reach, then the screen, then the log. The web zooms nothing; Android opens the screenshot in MonarchLightbox (pinch, double tap and zoom buttons), the native pattern for a picture to inspect, without the markers. The web forwards the person's pointer and keys to the remote screen while taken over (onPointer, onKey, role application); Android offers no remote input surface, because a pixel-level target has no TalkBack equivalent: the app shows its own remote-control screen when the person takes over. The web plays a MediaStream in a video element; Android takes the live picture as a slot. Screenshots are Painters the app loads, times are epoch milliseconds. The web moves focus to the button that replaced the one used; Android leaves focus to TalkBack, which reads the new button. The parity map lists ai-action-log as a dependency; MonarchAiActionLog is a product-wide audit list with undo, so this view has its own log with kinds, points, privacy and selection, as the web does. iOS has not built this component yet.
accessibility: The view is a traversal group named "Assistant browser view" (or computer).
The status and who is in control are written in words; color only repeats them.
The screen is one image element whose description is the screenshot's text and the latest action, with "View larger" as its action when a picture shows; without a picture it says why first.
Each logged action is one element read as kind, label, detail or "Hidden", and time; with onSelectAction it is selectable and read as selected.
The compact log button is read with "Expanded" or "Collapsed".

Status changes are announced once in a polite live region; a failure or a wait for the person in an assertive one. New actions are announced politely, several together, at most once per announceIntervalMillis. Private actions are announced as "Private action".
Every button and logged action has a 48dp target; markers are decorative and hidden from TalkBack.
In right to left the controls start at the right; the address stays left to right; text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: A private screenshot, the screenshot after a private action and a private live picture are never shown, and the lightbox cannot open them.
Typed text is withheld unless showTypedText; a private action's label and detail are never shown, whatever else is set.
Points outside the screenshot are drawn on its edge; points without a frame size are not drawn.
Long sessions: only the newest visibleActions actions are composed until "Show earlier".
The actions present at first are not announced; announcements restart if the view leaves the composition.
The view is a plain column: put it in a scrolling screen, not in a lazy list item that must stay small.

examples.title: Live session
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiComputerView(
    status = status,
    frame = MonarchAiComputerFrame(
        image = sampleSignInPainter(), // the app's screenshot painter
        width = {{frame.width}},
        height = {{frame.height}},
        capturedAt = {{frame.capturedAt|millis}},
        alt = {{frame.alt}},
    ),
    actions = listOf(
        MonarchAiComputerAction(
            id = {{actions.0.id}},
            kind = MonarchAiComputerActionKind.{{actions.0.kind|pascal}},
            label = {{actions.0.label}},
            at = {{actions.0.at|millis}},
            detail = {{actions.0.detail}},
        ),
        MonarchAiComputerAction(
            id = {{actions.1.id}},
            kind = MonarchAiComputerActionKind.{{actions.1.kind|pascal}},
            label = {{actions.1.label}},
            at = {{actions.1.at|millis}},
        ),
    ),
    currentUrl = {{currentUrl}},
    windowTitle = {{windowTitle}},
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    timeZone = {{timeZone}},
    onPauseChange = { paused ->
        status = if (paused) MonarchAiComputerViewStatus.Paused else MonarchAiComputerViewStatus.Working
    },
    onTakeOver = { status = MonarchAiComputerViewStatus.TakenOver },
    onHandBack = { status = MonarchAiComputerViewStatus.Working },
    onStop = { status = MonarchAiComputerViewStatus.Stopped },
)

examples.title: Waiting for the person, with a compact log
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiComputerView(
    status = MonarchAiComputerViewStatus.WaitingForYou,
    waitingReason = "Sign in with your company account to continue",
    onTakeOver = { /* show the app's remote-control screen */ },
    compact = true,
)
